'''2010 US East Nationals Seth Acree LS Watch Your Step''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Seth Acree]] at [[2010 US East Nationals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough|Ref2-L-watchyourstep.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Acree's WYS Raiders
* '''Username:''' sjacree
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
